title: Will Hurd joins OpenAI’s board of directors
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
OpenAI is committed to developing general-purpose artificial intelligence that benefits all humanity, and we believe that achieving our goal requires expertise in public policy as well as technology. So, we’re delighted to announce that Congressman Will Hurd has joined our board of directors.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/will-hurd-joins).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
